notes.title: Instructions, levels and achievements
notes.content:
Added instructions and hints to the first levels.
The mushroom from our game Porcini came to visit and can tell you how to score points to go to a new level. 
New levels and achievements have been added, a total of 30 levels and 30 achievements are available.
Improved balance, fixed bugs.

notes.title: Even more Donuts and Pizza
notes.content:
Fixed bugs
Improved interface
Added 15 levels and 15 achievements
A total of 20 levels and 20 achievements are available in the game
